body.name: globally Lipschitz observational cell-value extension
body.construction: For \(u\in\mathbb R_+^4\) with \(s(u)>0\), define \(g_{a,\epsilon}(u):=s(u)u_{a1}/\max\{s_a(u),\epsilon s(u)\}\) and \(\bar f_\epsilon(u):=\max_{a\in\{0,1\}}g_{a,\epsilon}(u)\); set \(g_{a,\epsilon}(0)=\bar f_\epsilon(0)=0\).
